en-US.name: Next Train
en-US.summary: Get real-time next-train arrivals and delay/detour status for PATH and MTA subway.
en-US.description: Next Train tells you when your next PATH or MTA subway train is arriving, and whether there are any delays or service alerts you should plan around. Ask for any supported station and line, such as Grove Street, 33rd Street, the A train, or the 1/2/3 at World Trade Center.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask Next Train when's my next train at Grove Street
Alexa, ask Next Train if there are any delays on the A line

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Ask about the default stations: PATH Grove Street, PATH 33rd Street, MTA A line near 9th Street, and MTA 1/2/3 at World Trade Center.
